transcript.content:
<issue>
[beta10] OCR retults are broken when containing "
When OCRing VobSub subtitles with PaddleOCR Standalone, lines containing a double quote (`"`) seem to be parsed incorrectly.
More specifically, apostrophes (`'`) after the quote are escaped and become `\'`.

Example:
`" It's raining...`
becomes:
`" It\'s raining...`

I am not sure how this behaves when the line contains two double quotes. I can't find a good sub to test it. 

This may be caused by PaddleOCR using a different string representation when a double quote is present, which Subtitle Edit may not be parsing correctly.

I'm on Windows, if that helps.

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find the C# code that parses PaddleOCR standalone output (search for "PaddleOcr" and "\\'" or Replace("\\'"...)). Show the relevant parsing code with file paths and line numbers.

content.content: {"summary":"PaddleOCR standalone output is parsed in PaddleOcrResultParser.Parse, which PaddleOcr.cs calls from two output handlers. I found no code that handles `\\'` or calls Replace(\"\\\\'\"...). The text regex only accepts a quote character (`'` or `\"`) as the delimiter. An escaped quote inside the text, such as `\\'`, is not unescaped.","findings":["src/UI/Features/Ocr/Engines/PaddleOcrResultParser.cs:65-102: Parse(string input). Line 68 extracts the text with Regex `\\([\"'](.*)[\"'],` and line 69 takes group 1 with no unescaping. Line 72 strips spaces. Line 73 extracts the confidence with `(\\d+\\.\\d+)\\)\\]$`. Lines 77-87 extract the 4 bounding-box points with `\\[(\\d+\\.\\d+),(\\d+\\.\\d+)\\]`.","src/UI/Features/Ocr/Engines/PaddleOcr.cs:545-562: the single-image output handler splits the line on \"ppocr INFO: \" (line 545) and takes arr[1] as data. It validates data with a full-line regex (lines 553-554) and, on a match, calls parser.Parse(data) (559) and adds the result to _textDetectionResults.","src/UI/Features/Ocr/Engines/PaddleOcr.cs:605-622: the batch handler OutputHandlerBatch does the same split, regex check and Parse call (620).","src/UI/Features/Ocr/Engines/PaddleOcr.cs:484-494: MakeResult joins the results. Its only Replace is at line 494, `.Replace(\" \" + Environment.NewLine, Environment.NewLine)`.","Example output format is in the comment at PaddleOcr.cs:565: [[[92.0, 56.0], ...], ('My mommy always said', 0.99...)]"],"confidence":0.85}
